title: Normalized derived-pullback coherence data for determinant pairs
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme] with the recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback], normalized determinant-pullback coherence data consist of natural isomorphisms $L(1_X)^*\simeq 1$ and $Lh^*\circ Lg^*\simeq L(g\circ h)^*$ for every $g:Y\to X$ and $h:Z\to Y$. Their composition maps are the universal lifts of the original counits and the section-normalized ordinary tensor-pullback comparisons [def-pc-module-pullback], as defined by twoTermDeterminantDerivedCompositionLift [def-trf-two-term-determinant-data]. The data satisfy the left unit, right unit and associativity equations. This is the plain structure TwoTermDeterminantPullbackCoherence, with no assertion of its existence.
